[[File:Class_Four_lineup.png|thumb|200px|A lineup of fourth-degree droids]]
A '''class four droid''' or '''fourth-degree droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programmed for military and security purposes. Such droids tended to perform tasks wherein violence or combat might be expected. Class four droids were grouped into four major categories: [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], which were used to guard locations; [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droids]], which were designed to battle other droids for sport; [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], which were the most common variety and used in standard combat; and [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], the only variety expressly designed to kill organics.
